stories.title: The Three Little Pigs
stories.zh: 三只小猪各自盖房，草房木房被大灰狼吹倒，只有砖房最结实，齐心赶走了狼。
sentences: Once there were three little pigs.
One pig made a house of straw.
One pig made a house of sticks.
One pig made a house of bricks.
A big bad wolf came to the straw house.
He huffed and puffed, and the straw house fell down!
The wolf came to the brick house.
He huffed and puffed, but the brick house stood strong.
The three pigs were safe and happy.

stories.title: Goldilocks and the Three Bears
stories.zh: 金发姑娘闯进熊家，尝了粥、坐了椅子、睡了床，熊回家发现了她，她红着逃跑了。
sentences: She tasted the three bowls of soup.
The little bowl was just right.
She slept on the little bed.
Goldilocks woke up and ran away.

stories.title: The Gingerbread Man
stories.zh: 姜饼人从烤箱里跳出来逃跑，谁都追不上他，最后却被聪明的狐狸吃掉了。
sentences: A little old woman made a gingerbread man.
The gingerbread man jumped out of the oven!
Run, run, as fast as you can!
You can not catch me. I am the gingerbread man!
The woman ran. The man ran.
A cow ran. A horse ran.
A fox said, "I can help you cross the river."
The gingerbread man jumped on the fox's nose.
The fox ate him all up!

stories.title: The Big Turnip
stories.zh: 老爷爷拔不动大萝卜，全家一个拉一个，连小老鼠都来帮忙，终于拔出来了。
sentences: It was a big, big turnip!
He could not pull it up.
The little dog and the little cat pulled too.
Pop! The big turnip came out!

stories.title: Little Red Riding Hood
stories.zh: 小红帽去看奶奶，大灰狼假扮奶奶，猎人及时赶到救了她们。
sentences: Little Red Riding Hood had a red hood.
She took a basket to grandma.
The wolf ran to grandma's house first.
"What big eyes you have!" said Little Red.
Grandma and Little Red were safe.

stories.title: The Ugly Duckling
stories.zh: 丑小鸭被大家嘲笑，孤独地长大，春天才发现自己是一只美丽的白天鹅。
sentences: Four eggs opened. Four little ducks came out.
The fifth duck was big and gray.
He ran away to the river.
Spring came, and he saw his shadow in the water.
He was a beautiful white swan!
He flew high in the sky, happy at last.

stories.title: The Three Goats
stories.zh: 三只山羊想过桥吃青草，用聪明和勇气战胜了桥下的大怪物。
sentences: Three goats wanted the green grass on the hill.
A big troll lived under the bridge.
The little goat walked on the bridge.
"Who is on my bridge?" said the troll.
The big goat came. He was strong.
He pushed the troll into the river.
The three goats ate the green grass all day.

stories.title: The Magic Pot
stories.zh: 神奇的锅会说咒语煮粥，却没人记得怎么让它停下，全村都是粥啦！
sentences: A little girl had a magic pot.
One day, the pot began to cook.
No one knew how to stop it!
"Stop, little pot, stop!" At last, the pot stopped.

stories.title: Stone Soup
stories.zh: 聪明的士兵用一块石头煮汤，村民们你一点我一点，煮出了全村最香的汤。
sentences: A hungry man came to a town.
He had a pot and a little stone.
"I can make stone soup!" he said.
He put the stone in the pot of water.
"It is good with a carrot," he said.
"It is good with some meat," he said.
"Yum! Stone soup is the best soup!"

stories.title: The Wolf and the Kids
stories.zh: 羊妈妈出门后大灰狼装成妈妈进门，小羊们用智慧最终平安团圆。
sentences: Mother Goat had seven little kids.
"Do not open the door for the wolf!"
The wolf knocked on the door.
"Your voice is not soft like Mom's!"
The wolf ate some honey. His voice was soft.
The wolf jumped in! The kids hid.
Mother Goat came home and found her kids.

stories.title: The Lion and the Mouse
stories.zh: 小老鼠救了大狮子——小小的朋友也能帮大忙。
sentences: A little mouse ran on his nose.
The lion woke up. He caught the mouse.
"Please let me go!" said the mouse.
The lion smiled and let her go.
One day, the lion was in a net.
She bit the net, bit and bit.
The lion was free! Small friends can be big helpers.

stories.title: The Race
stories.zh: 骄傲的兔子睡了一觉，慢慢走的乌龟赢了比赛。
sentences: A rabbit and a turtle had a race.
"You are so slow!" said the rabbit.
The rabbit ran fast, fast, fast.
The turtle walked slowly, step by step.
The turtle was far, far away.
The rabbit slept under a tree.
The turtle got to the end first!
Slow and steady wins the race.

stories.title: The Boy and the Wolf
stories.zh: 放羊的孩子两次说谎喊狼来了，狼真的来时没人再信他。
sentences: A little boy watched his sheep.
He was bored. He wanted fun.
But there was no wolf. The boy laughed.
The next day, he cried, "Wolf! Wolf!" again.
The farmers ran. No wolf. The boy laughed.
Do not tell lies, or no one will believe you.

stories.title: The Ant and the Grasshopper
stories.zh: 蚂蚁夏天忙存粮，蚱蜢只顾唱歌玩，冬天来了谁暖谁饿？
sentences: The ants worked day after day.
They put food in their little house.
"We must save food for winter," said the ants.
Winter came. It was cold and white.
The ants had warm soup every day.

stories.title: The Fox and the Grapes
stories.zh: 狐狸够不着葡萄就说葡萄是酸的——吃不到的东西才不稀罕呢！
sentences: He saw purple grapes on a tall tree.
He jumped. He could not get them.
He jumped again. Still no grapes.
He walked away with an empty tummy.
It is easy to say what you can not get is bad.

stories.title: The Crow and the Water
stories.zh: 口渴的乌鸦往瓶子里丢石子，水位升高，喝到了水。
sentences: She saw a bottle with a little water.
Her beak could not reach the water.
She put a little stone in the bottle.
The water came up a bit.
Stone after stone, the water came up.
At last, she drank the water!
Think hard, and you will find a way.

stories.title: The Wind and the Sun
stories.zh: 风和太阳比赛谁能让旅人脱下外套，温暖比强硬更有力量。
sentences: The wind and the sun had a talk.
A man in a coat walked by.
"Let us see who can take off his coat."
The man held his coat tight.
The sun smiled, warm and bright.

stories.title: The Dog and His Bone
stories.zh: 小狗叼着骨头看见水里的倒影，贪心一张嘴，骨头掉进水里了。
sentences: A dog had a big bone in his mouth.
He walked over a little bridge.
He looked down at the water.
He saw a dog with a bone!
"I want that bone too!" he thought.
He opened his mouth to bark.
His bone fell into the water!
The other dog was only his shadow.

stories.title: Two Little Mice
stories.zh: 城里食物好吃却有猫，乡下清贫却安心——平安简单才是真快乐。
sentences: A country mouse lived in a quiet field.
A city mouse came to visit.
"Your food is so simple," he said.
They ran to the city house.
They found bread and cheese and cake.
Then a big cat jumped in!
They ran and ran and hid in a little hole.
"I like my quiet field," said the country mouse.

stories.title: The Fox and the Crow
stories.zh: 狐狸夸乌鸦嗓子美，乌鸦一开口唱歌，嘴里的奶酪掉了。
sentences: A crow sat on a tree.
She had cheese in her beak.
A fox walked by. He was hungry.
She opened her beak to sing.
The fox ate it and ran away.

stories.title: The Cat's Red Balloon
stories.zh: 小猫心爱的红气球飞走了，朋友们帮它追，最后收获了满天气球。
sentences: A little cat had a red balloon.
The wind blew. The balloon flew up!
A bird flew up to help.
A monkey jumped high to help.
The balloon flew over the trees.
The cat was sad. Her friends hugged her.
"We are your balloons now!" they said.

stories.title: Panda's Picnic
stories.zh: 熊猫带竹子去野餐，遇见朋友分享食物，野餐变得热闹又开心。
sentences: Panda had a picnic in the sun.
He had green bamboo to eat.
A bear came by with honey.
They ate and ate under the sun.

stories.title: Duck's Rainy Day
stories.zh: 下雨了大家躲雨，只有小鸭子 happiest——雨天是它的游乐场。
sentences: Rain fell from the gray clouds.
The cat ran under a chair.
The bird flew to her nest.
The rabbit hid in his hole.
But the little duck was happy!
The rain was her best friend.
Some love sun. Some love rain.

stories.title: The Sleepy Bear
stories.zh: 熊怎么都睡不着，朋友们用歌声哄它入眠。
sentences: A big bear could not sleep.
He rolled left. He rolled right.
The moon came to see him.
The owl sang a soft song.
He had a sweet dream about honey.

stories.title: Rabbit's Big Carrot
stories.zh: 兔子拔出一根超级大萝卜，做成萝卜汤和全森林分享。
sentences: It was as big as a house!
The big carrot came out. Boom!
So rabbit made hot carrot soup.
Cat came. Dog came. Bear came.

stories.title: Monkey's Yellow Banana
stories.zh: 猴子找到一根大香蕉，一路忍住不吃想带回家，到家和家人分享。
sentences: Monkey found a big yellow banana.
"I will take it home to Mom."
At home, Mom cut the banana.
Monkey, Mom, and Dad each had a piece.
The banana was extra sweet at home.

stories.title: Dog Finds a Friend
stories.zh: 害羞的小狗想交朋友，一个滚皮球的动作带来了好朋友。
sentences: He saw kids playing with a ball.
But he was too shy to say hi.
The ball rolled to his feet.
Dog pushed the ball back with his nose!
Dog jumped and wagged his tail.
A ball can make a friend.

stories.title: The Bird's New Nest
stories.zh: 小鸟一根树枝一根草，耐心搭出温暖的新家。
sentences: A little bird needed a home.
She found a tall green tree.
She flew down for a stick.
She found soft grass and feathers.
The nest was round and warm.
Home is the best place to be.

stories.title: Fish and the Bubble
stories.zh: 小鱼追着泡泡玩，一路吐泡泡认识了新朋友。
sentences: A little fish saw a bubble.
The bubble went up, up, up.
Another little fish came to see.
The sea was full of round bubbles.

stories.title: Pig's Mud Bath
stories.zh: 小猪最爱泥巴澡，虽然脏兮兮，但快乐最重要。
sentences: It was a hot, hot day.
The sun was like a big fire ball.
The mud was cool and soft.
He rolled left. He rolled right.
A duck said, "You are so dirty!"
"But I am so happy!" said pig.

stories.title: Good Morning!
stories.zh: 跟着太阳一起起床，伸伸懒腰，开始美好一天。
sentences: I stretch my arms up high.
I get out of my warm bed.

stories.title: Brush, Brush, Brush
stories.zh: 上刷刷下刷刷，牙齿白白细菌跑光光。
sentences: Up and down, up and down.
Left and right, left and right.

stories.title: Breakfast Time
stories.zh: 早餐吃什么？面包、鸡蛋和牛奶，吃得饱饱去上学。
sentences: Here is a cup of milk.
Now I am ready for school.

stories.title: The School Bus
stories.zh: 黄色校车嘟嘟来，排队上车去学校。
sentences: I wait in line with my friends.
The wheels go round and round.

stories.title: In the Classroom
stories.zh: 教室里学字母、数数字、唱唱歌，课堂真有趣。

stories.title: Playtime!
stories.zh: 操场上跑步、跳绳、滑滑梯，玩得满头大汗。
sentences: We run out to the yard.
I run fast like the wind.
I go down the slide. Whee!
One, two, three. I see you!
My face is red and hot.

stories.title: Yummy Dinner
stories.zh: 晚饭有米饭、青菜和鱼，不挑食才能长高高。
sentences: I try one bite of everything.
I will grow big and strong.

stories.title: Bath Time
stories.zh: 泡泡飞满天，洗得香喷喷。
sentences: The bubbles fly up, up, up!
Now I am clean and warm.

stories.title: One More Story
stories.zh: 睡前想再听一个故事，妈妈说：听完这个就睡觉。
sentences: I am in my little bed.
The story is about a dragon.
I close my eyes. Sweet dreams.

stories.title: Good Night
stories.zh: 和月亮星星道晚安，好好睡觉明天见。

stories.title: One Red Apple
stories.zh: 树上有苹果，数一数：一个、两个……红苹果真多呀。
sentences: Now I see two red apples.
One for me, one for you.
Now I see three red apples.
Red like the sun at sunset.
How many apples do you see?

stories.title: Two Little Shoes
stories.zh: 左脚一只右脚一只，两只鞋是好朋友。
sentences: This one is for my left foot.
This one is for my right foot.
They are blue like the sky.
Tap, tap, tap on the floor.

stories.title: Three Happy Birds
stories.zh: 三只小鸟站树枝，唱歌跳舞真快乐。
sentences: One little bird on a tree.
Two little birds, you and me.
Three little birds sing a song.
They sing to the morning sun.
They dance on the little branch.

stories.title: Four Orange Fish
stories.zh: 橙色小鱼水里游，游来游去做游戏。
sentences: Three orange fish make a circle.
Four orange fish play a game!
The bubbles go pop, pop, pop.
The water is their happy home.

stories.title: Five Green Frogs
stories.zh: 五只青蛙跳跳跳，一只一只跳进池。
sentences: Five green frogs on a log.
One frog jumps into the pool.
Now there are four green frogs.
The last frog jumps in too!
Where are the frogs? In the pool!

stories.title: Six Yellow Ducks
stories.zh: 鸭妈妈带着小鸭子排队走，一摇一摆去池塘。
sentences: One, two, three, four, five, six!
Splash! One by one, they swim.
"Stay close to me," says Mother Duck.
Six little ducks are happy ducks.

stories.title: Seven Balloons
stories.zh: 七个气球七种颜色， rainbow 一样漂亮。
sentences: The third is yellow, like the sun.
The fourth is green, like the grass.
The fifth is blue, like the sky.
The sixth is purple, like a plum.
The seventh is pink, like a flower.
They look like a rainbow party.

stories.title: Eight Cookies
stories.zh: 奶奶烤了八块饼干，全家一人一块刚刚好。
sentences: One for Grandma. One for Grandpa.
One for Dad. One for Mom.
One for my sister. One for me.
And two for my teddy bear!

stories.title: Nine White Clouds
stories.zh: 天上白云变变变，一会儿像羊一会儿像龙。
sentences: I lie on the green grass.
I look up at the sky.
This cloud looks like a sheep.
That cloud looks like a rabbit.
The big one looks like a dragon!
The wind blows. The clouds move.
Now the sheep is a boat.

stories.title: Ten Little Stars
stories.zh: 数星星入睡，一颗两颗……十颗星星眨眼睛。
sentences: The night is dark and quiet.
I look out of my window.
